Keep a clear round gap between the two palms, NO ball drawn, NO prayer hands. Wrists higher than elbows. Anatomically plausible shoulder-elbow-wrist-fingers in all poses.
NO background, backlight, glow, colored halo or scattered pixels. Ignore all glow from the reference. Crisp clean true-alpha silhouettes with no outside debris. No text, labels, panels or shadows.
